queries.query: select case when total_llevar is null then 0 else total_llevar end as total_llevar from( select sum(ll.valor_total) as total_llevar from llevar ll where ll.fecha_orden between :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and ll.estado_orden='A' )sub

SELECT CASE WHEN sub0.valor_total is null THEN 0 ELSE sub0.valor_total END as valor_total from( SELECT sum(l.valor_total ) as valor_total FROM llevar l WHERE (l.id_dian is not null and l.id_dian > 0) and l.fecha_orden BETWEEN :fechaInicial and :fechaFinal and l.estado_orden='A' )sub0
